description: React component for a card dialog in a project management or kanban-style application, including features like template duplication, deletion, attachment management, and permissions.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining properties for the CardDialog component.

methods.name: makeTemplateClicked
methods.description: Handles creating a new template from the current card, tracking telemetry, and duplicating the card.

methods.name: handleDeleteCard
methods.description: Deletes the current card and tracks telemetry.

methods.name: confirmDialogProps
methods.description: Configuration object for the confirmation dialog when deleting a card.

methods.name: handleDeleteButtonOnClick
methods.description: Handles user click for delete button, showing confirmation if needed.

methods.name: removeUploadingAttachment
methods.description: Removes an attachment block that is in uploading state.

methods.name: selectAttachment
methods.description: Prompts user to select a file and uploads it as an attachment, updating progress and handling success/failure.

methods.name: addElement
methods.description: Adds a new attachment element to the card.

methods.name: attachBtn
methods.description: Renders the attach button with permission gating.
